alternates.summary: Managing Editor for Asian Equities at Bloomberg News Lianting Tu says tighter access to chips could constrain AI model training in China and potentially slow sales growth for AI cloud businesses. That could have a knock-on effect on data-center expansion and demand for Chinese hardware companies, some of which supply Nvidia, as the Trump administration moves to limit countries from providing Chinese companies remote access to advanced artificial intelligence chips and servers. (Source: Bloomberg)
alternates.title: Impact of US Move to Curb Chip Access
